instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind configuration to define custom colors: terracotta (#C4633A), charcoal (#2B2B2B), off-white (#F7F3EF).
Install and use 'lucide-react' for icons as it fits the clean marketplace look.
Do not use generic blue/yellow. Rely strictly on the custom color palette.
Implement the Flipkart-style layout: sticky top navigation (search + cart + login), secondary category navigation bar, and left sidebar for filters on listing pages.
Product cards must be grid-based, high-density, but spaced elegantly using E1 padding rules (e.g., p-4 on cards).
Use solid background colors for headers and dropdowns. NO transparent backgrounds for content-overlaying elements.
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (e.g., buttons, input fields, navigation links).
Include hover states and focus outlines for all interactive elements to ensure accessibility.
For the UI components, you can use HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts and customized Shadcn components for complex interactions like Modals, Dropdowns, Selects, and Tabs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not create generic centered layouts. Ensure layered design with z-index hierarchy.
Add micro-animations for hover states and transitions on interactive elements. Static UIs are dead.

Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable to avoid cramped designs, but balance this with Flipkart's high-density commerce pattern by keeping individual product cards compact but grid gaps generous.
Never use AI emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Do not apply global 'transition: all' styles.
